assessment.rationale: This application cannot proceed to eligibility determination. All four documents in the applicant's file failed to open due to PDF parsing errors, leaving every criterion unverified. The applicant's name, identity, income, employment status, and any existing loan obligations remain entirely unknown. Without readable income proof (salary slip, employment letter, bank statement) and loan documents (sanction letter, loan statement), FOIR cannot be calculated, income consistency cannot be assessed, and borrower identity cannot be confirmed across documents. The file also lacks critical collateral and liability documentation. The decision is NEEDS_REVIEW pending resubmission of valid, readable documents.
